title: Andrean Ignasius
subtitle: Master’s in Data Science | Machine Operator (Print Finishing Experience)
about: Master’s in Data Science (High Distinction, Deakin University) with a Bachelor’s in Computer Science from Bina Nusantara University. Awarded Best Research Paper at ICCSCI 2021 and former Data Scientist at Telkom Indonesia, with experience building end-to-end computer vision and machine learning pipelines. Recently gained hands-on experience in industrial print finishing and manufacturing operations as a Machine Operator (Christmas Casual) at Prima PMI. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and experienced working across both technical and operational environments.

experience.title: Machine Operator (Christmas Casual)
description: Worked across Calender, Guillotine (cut finishing), and Shipping departments during peak production periods.
Assisted in operating industrial print-finishing machinery including Renz Inline 500, Renz AP 360 Digital, Uchida VS-20 paper drill, and Uchida Countron tabbing machine.
Supported high-volume punching, drilling, tabbing, and finishing operations while maintaining quality and safety standards.
Contributed to meeting daily and monthly production KPIs of approximately 14,000 finished units during peak seasonal demand.
Performed routine machine maintenance including cleaning, lubrication, setup checks, and minor troubleshooting to minimise downtime.
Conducted quality checks to ensure consistency and accuracy across finished paper products.
Used RF scanning systems for job tracking, inventory control, and workflow coordination.
Assisted with material handling, packaging, and shipping preparation to meet dispatch deadlines.
Adapted quickly across machines and departments to support fluctuating workloads in a fast-paced production environment.

experience.title: Pet Sitter

Maintained regular communication with pet owners and provided daily updates and care reports.

experience.title: Data Scientist

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and align ML solutions with business objectives.
Provided comprehensive documentation and conducted knowledge transfer sessions for stakeholders.
